meta.title: [alpha_factory] add LRU cache size limit
meta.body_summary: Implement size-capped OrderedDict cache in llm_provider with AF_LLM_CACHE_SIZE env var, verify LRU eviction via unit test, and update documentation.

perf_labels.notes: Self-merged cache limit PR with unit test but no human review or performance benchmark; merged instantly without evidence challenge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 375 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit. It fits a focused, low-risk performance PR with test coverage that merged instantly without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review text available; PR merged by author without human feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Limit LLM provider cache to AF_LLM_CACHE_SIZE entries using LRU eviction to prevent unbounded memory growth.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cache limit implementation is a straightforward data structure change; no binary interface or platform dependency barriers. Merge friction is minimal for such a self-contained patch with tests.

core_change_summary.description: In alpha_factory_v1/backend/utils/llm_provider.py, wrapped the existing OrderedDict cache with a maxsize limit (AF_LLM_CACHE_SIZE) using simple LRU eviction on overflow; added a unit test test_llm_cache.py to validate eviction behavior; updated README with the new env var.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: README change documents AF_LLM_CACHE_SIZE; test file validates LRU eviction.
